title: Gas Emissions 3 — official accounting, energy, ETS, efficiency, heat-network and landfill QA controls

sources.title: ONS Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions
ONS Environment climate and nature insights UK 2026
ONS renewable and waste energy use
UK ETS maritime how to comply
UK local and regional GHG technical report

packages.title: ONS three-basis GHG separation
facts: Territorial, residence and footprint emissions have different boundaries.

packages.title: ONS 2025 territorial estimate
facts: ONS reports a 2025 territorial emissions estimate.
Do not mix with 2024 residence data.

packages.title: ONS 2024 residence-basis emissions
facts: Residence emissions align with National Accounts.

packages.title: ONS footprint boundary
facts: Footprint emissions use a consumption boundary.

packages.title: ONS GHG intensity per GVA
facts: GHG intensity is emissions per economic output.
Do not treat intensity as absolute emissions.

packages.title: ONS household versus industry shares
facts: Household and industry shares are residence-basis statistics.
Do not mix shares with totals.

packages.title: ONS direct energy Mtoe
facts: Direct energy use is reported in Mtoe.
Do not treat Mtoe as CO2e.

packages.title: ONS fossil energy share
facts: Fossil fuel share describes energy mix.
Do not treat share as emissions.

packages.title: ONS renewable energy share
facts: Renewable share describes direct energy use.

packages.title: ONS renewable source composition
facts: Renewable source categories include wind, wave and tidal.
Do not equate generation mix with emissions.

packages.title: ONS fossil table exclusions
facts: The fossil-fuel table excludes biofuels and waste.

packages.title: ONS renewable/waste industry dimensions
facts: Renewable and waste energy use is split by source and industry.

packages.title: ONS renewable heat technology scope
facts: Renewable heat data include solar heat, heat pumps and geothermal.
Do not convert deployment to emissions.

packages.title: ONS revision guard
facts: ONS datasets may receive planned revisions.
Do not treat planned revision as source error.

packages.title: ONS climate and nature indicator boundary
facts: Climate and nature insights combine multiple indicators.
Do not treat article indicators as parcel measurements.

packages.title: ONS environmental goods GVA
facts: Environmental goods output and GVA are economic measures.
Do not treat GVA as emissions.

packages.title: UK ETS installation threshold
facts: UK ETS installation scope includes specified combustion above 20MW thermal input.
Do not infer emissions from capacity alone.

packages.title: UK ETS Northern Ireland electricity boundary
facts: Northern Ireland electricity generators remain in EU ETS.

packages.title: UK ETS reporting deadline
facts: Verified reports are generally due by 31 March.
Deadline is not an emissions value.

packages.title: UK ETS surrender deadline
facts: Allowance surrender is a compliance obligation.
Allowance quantity is not a parcel measurement.

packages.title: UK ETS maritime first scheme year
facts: The first maritime scheme year starts 1 July 2026.

packages.title: UK ETS maritime gas species
facts: Maritime monitoring covers CO2, N2O and CH4.

packages.title: UK ETS maritime allowance rule
facts: One allowance corresponds to one tonne CO2e for surrender.
Do not use as parcel conversion factor.

packages.title: UK ETS maritime surrender deduction
facts: Surrender deductions affect the compliance figure.

packages.title: UK ETS METS workflow
facts: Account status is not emissions data.

packages.title: HEE provisional status
facts: Installation counts are not measurements of GHG.

packages.title: HEE T1.6 correction
facts: Table T1.6 was corrected on 25 June 2026.

packages.title: HEE measures versus estimated savings
facts: Installed measures and estimated savings are different fields.
Do not call savings measured emissions.

packages.title: Heat-pump 45kW scope
facts: Deployment statistics cover hydronic heat pumps up to 45kW.

packages.title: Heat-pump statistics development status
facts: Heat-pump deployment is official statistics in development.

packages.title: GBIS installation activity
facts: Installation is not direct emissions measurement.

packages.title: GBIS geography
facts: Do not silently expand to UK.

packages.title: Warm Homes Local Grant England scope
Warm Homes Local Grant reporting lag
facts: WH:LG data are one month in arrears.

packages.title: Local GHG model versus measurement
facts: Local GHG estimates combine models and administrative data.
Do not label all values measured.

packages.title: Local GHG uncertainty
facts: Local estimates have sector-specific spatial uncertainty.

packages.title: Heat-network project stages
facts: HNPD tracks inception, planning, construction, operation and decommissioning.

packages.title: HNPD planning/developer evidence
facts: HNPD uses planning applications and developer contacts.
Planning evidence is not operational GHG.

packages.title: Regional renewable metrics
facts: Regional data separate site count, capacity, generation and load factor.
Do not equate capacity with generation.

packages.title: Landfill fugitive versus point-source emissions
facts: Landfill reporting separates fugitive gas from point-source combustion.

packages.title: Cross-source unit and boundary guard
facts: Energy, economic, installation and emissions units are distinct.

packages.title: Cross-source parcel inference guard
facts: These sources do not alone establish measured parcel emissions.
